bayts.text: O Allah, O Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), bless for ever the Arab Prophet, Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and cut off my doing of what You are not pleased with for me, that it may be cut off
through You, without blight or turbidity, O Lord of creatures, of decree and of destiny.
And bless, O Gentle, for ever him who did all that You commanded,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And erase through him all that has come from me that is not good pleasure, and lead the joy of destiny to me.
And bless, O Gentle, and grant peace upon him through whom You dispelled the darknesses,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And free me from all that You have not chosen for me; and make me aware of it and veil it.
And bless, O Loving, and grant peace upon him to whom I turned my pen,
through You, for years, worshipping You through him; and through him You led to me the wishes of the wakeful.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And accept with thanks, by his immense rank, my life, and with Your good pleasure, Lord, make all of me flourish.
And bless, O Benefactor, and grant peace upon the Hashimite Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him all my being, without harm, a benefit, and be for me with fair things and pearls.
And bless, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), and grant peace upon him through whom I lead the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me sound knowledge with "Be!", O You Who bring into being wishes that were not.
And bless, O Gentle, and grant peace upon the Prophet, my means of approach and my ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me through him a kindness and a covering that are beautiful, and a triumph and a security that are complete.
And bless, O One, and grant peace upon him through whom I was spared pain,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me illness before it heads (for me), and be for me, through him, in every aim.
And bless, O Benefactor, and grant peace upon him whom whoever knew has loved,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And accept from me through him, and raise my striving toward You, that it may rise with good pleasure.
And turn all (my) evil deeds into good deeds (Qurʾān 25:70), and through him make my creeds commendable.
And bless, O Everlasting, with a blessing and peace, him to whom my pens have yielded,
through You, for love of Your noble Essence and of his, O You Who make his honour everlasting.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And choose for me what is finest in every land, and through him make my life the best of favours.
And grant me paper and ink, and grant me pens and affection.
And bless, O You Who make the hard easy, with Your peace, without hardship,
the Prophet, the Select, the Preferred, the Family and the Companions; and favour all of me.
O Sender, Who gave the Prophet a Remembrance, bless and grant peace, and accept (my) gratitude,
upon him who has no rival, the best of creation, possessed of distinctions, my protector,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today the soundness of my outward and inward, (making me) the best servant, pure.
And grant me today the recovery of all the good I have missed, O All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ),
without affectation or toil, O best of those addressed intimately with praise.
You are the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), truly You are the All-Knowing, and truly You are the Everlasting: Yours is the teaching.
O Allah, You are the Most Generous, the Guide, the One; O Benefactor, to Whom none is equal (Qurʾān 112:4),
bless with a peace without end the Prophet of Allah, bestower of gifts,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me gratitude and grant me knowledge, and never direct injustice toward me.
And grant me from You a clear permanence, and make my speech beneficial and healing.
And grant me recitation and all You have chosen for me with it, (making me) trustworthy, a ladder (for others).
And spare me, until the Gardens, all that You are not pleased with for me, and through me benefit the learned.
O You Who make the hard easy, bless and grant peace upon the Prophet who prays,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And efface the turning of faults toward me, O best of those who remove harm by effacement.
And make me free of need through You and through the accepted Intercessor, until the Gardens; and raise my station.
And do not remove from me the good things and the Book, and do not turn reproach toward my person.
And make everlasting for me safety and success, and love and purity, Lord, and righteousness.
And write for me today, without deprivation, the most lasting of permanences, that frees from all asking.
And make my permanence Your good pleasure and the good pleasure of the best of creation, and through him make my life good pleasure.
And bless, O Most Generous, and grant peace upon him whom You sent as a teacher,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me the rewards and the wonders, and gain in the two Abodes, and the stations.
And bless, O One, and grant peace upon him who helps whoever has learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And through him make all my being one that proclaims the Oneness, submitting (Muslim), excellent in virtue and a guide.
And bless, O You Who veil faults with generosity and know the hidden things,
upon him who surpassed all creatures entirely, with a peace that makes piety grow for me,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And efface all (my) faults, and suffice me against what is not Your good pleasure, freeing me from (having to say) "Heal me".
And bless, O You Who forgive sins with a generosity that fills the buckets,
with Your peace without end, upon the son of ʿAbd Allāh, possessed of splendour,
